messages:
natalie-peopleops: Heads up — final pay for Lucas (employee ID 5921) shows both US Social Security withheld and Spanish Seguridad Social contributions taken. He was moved to Spanish payroll on 2025-11-01 and offboarded 2026-03-15. Can payroll confirm if totalization / certificate of coverage was applied?

matt-payroll: can you share the payrun id or paste the stub lines? i'll pull the run.

natalie-peopleops: payrun id is `PR-2026-0315-5921`. stub snippet below:
```
Gross salary: 5,000.00 EUR
US Social Security (FICA): 310.00 EUR
Spanish Seguridad Social: 220.00 EUR
Income tax (ES): 550.00 EUR
Net paid: 3,920.00 EUR
```

global-payroll-bot: payrun PR-2026-0315-5921 processed at 2026-03-16T02:12:08Z. For inquiries open a ticket with payroll and include source docs.

matt-payroll: thanks. looking — initial glance shows our system didn't receive a Certificate of Coverage (totalization) for this employee. if there is coverage we can reverse the US SS withholding and request refund through AP. cc @sara-legal for confirmation on docs and whether we need a W-2C.

sara-legal: if the Certificate of Coverage is valid for the relevant dates (2025-11-01 -> 2026-03-15) we typically request a refund from SSA and issue a W-2C to correct Social Security withholding. need the cert + copy of the paystub + employee consent to file.

lucas-ex: hi team — i did submit a UK/ES certificate of coverage to relocations@redwood on 2026-02-20. i still have the email thread and the PDF, i can forward now. i also attached passport stamp showing start date in Spain.

anna-hr-ops: @matt-payroll i can forward the relocations inbox thread and the PDF. forwarding in 2 mins. pls confirm preferred upload location (hr-files? payroll-uploads?).

matt-payroll: please upload to `payroll-uploads/PR-4729` (we're creating the ticket now). AP needs the original bank details for refund to avoid check delays. also note: refund should be net of employer portion? we'll confirm once AP runs numbers.

sophie-finance: tagging AP — when you create the vendor refund request include field `refund_to_employee: true` and reference `PR-2026-0315-5921` so we don't route to vendor payments.

matt-payroll: created internal ticket PR-4729. next steps: 1) collect cert + paystub + consent; 2) submit refund request to AP; 3) if SSA refund succeeds, prepare W-2C for year 2026 to remove SS withholding. timeline ~ 4-6 weeks depending on SSA/AP. i'll update this thread. :thumbsup:

natalie-peopleops: thanks — please cc me and mark as high priority. Lucas lives in Spain now and asked for refund to go back to his original IBAN (same account used for final pay).

lucas-ex: confirmed — same IBAN. i've just forwarded the email with the Certificate of Coverage and passport pages to payroll-uploads and cc'd natalie.

matt-payroll: got the files. filing docs with AP now. one quick note: if SSA requires employee signature on the refund form we'll ask Lucas for e-sign.

sara-legal: also note we may need to provide a short letter explaining the secondment timeline and payroll ownership to satisfy the Spanish authority if they query it. i'll draft a template.

matt-payroll: added sara's note to ticket. will post updates here once AP confirms refund initiation. ETA first status update by 2026-04-02.

natalie-peopleops: great — thanks everyone. appreciate the quick turn. :pray:

global-payroll-bot: Ticket PR-4729 created and assigned to matt-payroll. SLA: 14 days to initial action.
